definitions.explanation: A formal written work presenting research, arguments, or analysis on a particular subject, especially for academic purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{論文|ろんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.notes: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{論文|ろんぶん} = graduation thesis

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表：03562_happyou⟧。
examples.english: I presented my paper at an academic conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{論文|ろんぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学術|がくじゅつ}→学術：12280_gakujutsu⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}された→掲載：08993_keisai⟧。
examples.english: This paper was published in an academic journal.

notes:
USAGE: {論文|ろんぶん} specifically refers to academic or scholarly papers, theses, and dissertations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {論文|ろんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a paper)
- {論文|ろんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表：03562_happyou⟧ (to present a paper)
- ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{論文|ろんぶん} (graduation thesis)
- ⟦{修士|しゅうし}→修士：11098_shuushi⟧{論文|ろんぶん} (master's thesis)
- ⟦{博士|はくし}→博士：03551_hakase⟧{論文|ろんぶん} (doctoral dissertation)
- ⟦{学術|がくじゅつ}→学術：12280_gakujutsu⟧{論文|ろんぶん} (academic paper)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {論文|ろんぶん} - academic paper, formal research
- ⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧ - essay, composition (school level)
- ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧ - article (journalism)
